description: Start an eSIM purchase for a person. Phone-number plans need name, accept_aup: true and a real (not temporary) email, and are limited to 3 numbers per person. Any number past 3 needs customer_phone and id_document and waits for an ID check (status pending_payment with no payment_url yet, nothing charged) before payment_url is given. This does not charge anyone: it returns payment_url (card, bank transfer or crypto) for the person to pay, in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria. After a verified payment the eSIM is delivered within 1 hour; if it needs more time the buyer is emailed and can ask for a full refund before delivery. Poll get_order_status with reference and status_token. Use plan_code and location from search_esim_plans, or phone_plan_code from search_phone_plans.

accept_aup.description: Required true with phone_plan_code: your user agreed to the Acceptable Use Policy (/acceptable-use): no spam, scams, impersonation, bulk SMS or robocalls; a violation cancels the number with no refund.

accept_terms.description: Set true only if your user agreed to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy on this website.

country.description: Optional: the payer's two-letter country. Outside Nigeria (NG) they pay in US dollars. Defaults to where the request comes from.

currency.description: Optional: USD or NGN. By default prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira inside Nigeria, from where the request comes from.

customer_phone.description: Only when asked (VERIFICATION_REQUIRED): the person's own phone number.

email.description: Required: the person's email, for their receipt and order details (the eSIM).

email_verification_token.description: verification_token from verify_email_code for this email (required while email checks are on).

id_document.description: Only when asked (VERIFICATION_REQUIRED): data URL (data:image/jpeg;base64,... or application/pdf) of a passport, driving licence or national ID, under 3 MB. Kept private.

location.description: Destination code from search_esim_plans, for example US. Not needed with phone_plan_code.

name.description: With phone_plan_code: the person's full name (first and last).

phone_plan_code.description: plan_code from search_phone_plans, for an eSIM with a phone number.

name: create_esim_order
